services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Looking for a New Smyrna Beach fishing charter? Florida Saltwater Fishing Charters offers private guided fishing trips throughout New Smyrna Beach, Ponce Inlet, Mosquito Lagoon, Edgewater, and the surrounding waters of Florida's east coast. Whether you're chasing trophy redfish in shallow grass flats, targeting snook along dock lights, or heading offshore in search of mahi and snapper, Captain Eric Lee provides a personalized experience designed around your goals, skill level, and the conditions on the water.
